race.description: Charlton Cup Day March 21st Mdn Trot
race.comment: COLLEAGUES (7) was out of the money two runs ago then broke and finished fifth last start over 1690m at Maryborough, coming home 35 metres from the winner. Big chance if he behaves in this similar assignment. OLIVER SMUDGE (5) is back from a break of three-and-a-half years and looks to be right up to the mark following a recent trial win. Sure to prove hard to beat on his return. SOME DAYS WE DREAM (1) last appeared when sixth over 2100m at this track ten months ago. Look out for any positive market movement. PETITE FOUR (6) is a six-year-old mare from the K G Whelan yard on debut. Will be ready to run a big race.
